title: Executor v2 Now Lets AI Agents Drive Automation Workflows via Code
summary:
The developers of the Executor platform have introduced a new software release that grants artificial intelligence models the ability to operate automation tools through a programming interface. The update is designed to support various system integrations and utility scenarios that the company says were previously restricted by the product's architecture.

Rhys Sullivan said the v2 version represents a total overhaul that exposes all platform features to an agent's control, creating a functional equivalent to a code-driven version of tools like Zapier or Retool. The change allows users to unlock previously limited use cases by making the entire ecosystem drivable as code.
